Hero_Desc_Lethe:
A phantom who carries a laser pointer.
Lethe's laser is said to have the ability to temporarily erase memories.
She is notorious for being a laser terrorist who haunts all over Elias.
Album_Like_Lethe: The refreshing feeling of forgetting bad memories.
Album_Hate_Lethe: The unpleasant sensation of remembering something you had forgotten.
Album_Hobby_Lethe: Thinking of catchphrases and poses before using her ability.
Album_Wish_Lethe: Using her power to make everyone forget bad memories and be happy.
Album_Lethe1: When talking with Lethe, I noticed that compared to other lively phantoms, she seems quiet and cold. Her conversations always revolve around the topic of memories, but I still don't fully understand why.
Album_Lethe2: I asked about the short stick she always carries, and Lethe immediately showed it to me. Then, she pressed a button, and a red light shone directly into my—AAH! It's just a laser pointer?!
Album_Lethe3: Apparently, Lethe's ability is to make people forget things by shining a laser pointer into their eyes. Isn't that a terrifying power?!
Album_Lethe4: I once ran into Lethe looking dazed. When I greeted her, she just stared at me blankly and asked, "Who are you?" It turned out she had accidentally used her power on herself. Is it really okay for her to keep recklessly erasing her own memories like this?
Album_Lethe5: In the Werebeast Forest, I saw Lethe playing with Kommy. Lethe pointed the laser at the ground, and Kommy eagerly chased after it... wait. Why does this scene feel so familiar?
Album_Lethe6: Lethe firmly believes that she's doing a good deed by erasing people's bad memories. However, other people don't quite see it that way. Most just find her an annoying nuisance who jumps out of nowhere and randomly shines lasers into people's eyes.
Album_Lethe7: One day, Lethe asked me to hit her. I lightly smacked her on the head, and she immediately whipped out her laser pointer and shined it into her own eyes. Hours later, when she regained her memory, I asked why she did that. She explained that the moment when she forgets both pain and bad memories feels incredibly good. That response unsettled me... so I decided not to ask any further.
LoveHero_Lethe:
I wish
I had one more
laser pointer!
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Hate1: She said that the pungent smell of pine needles ruined her mood and used the laser pointer on herself. When she tried to eat it again, I quickly put the pine needle porridge away.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Hate2: She was distressed by the slippery texture because it brought back bad memories of dropping the laser pointer from her hand.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like1: She was amused by the laser light bouncing all over off the candy. After making her promise she would only play with the candy at home, I served her the food.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like2: She smiled meaningfully, saying that the hollow taste was just like her after using the laser pointer. Is that a good thing?
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like3: She must have liked it, as she quickly finished a bowl of the rice cake soup. She then pretended to use the laser pointer on herself, asking for another bowl as if nothing happened.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like4: She said that she doesn't like sweetness per se, but there's something about eating sweets that makes her feel good.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like5: Not expecting to be so obsessed with its refreshing taste, she enthusiastically kept clicking on the laser pointer. Thanks to that, the Banquet Hall was filled with noise.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like6: She played with her songpyeon for a long time, saying she liked its squishy feel. When I told her that she shouldn't play with her food, she repeatedly pointed the laser at my face in rebellion.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like7: Lethe said it reminded her of the first time she ate nuts. I was relieved that today's meal would also be one of those memories for her.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like8: After polishing off every last grain of powder, she said she feels the happiest when the effects of nutritional supplements spread throughout her body.
Food_ChefNote_Lethe_Like9: After a closer look at the candy's colors, she muttered that she wished the light from her laser pointer also came in different colors.

LoveLetter_Lethe:
Master, it is me, Lethe.

I never imagined I would write you a letter. You become angry whenever I fire my laser, but I always have a reason. I hope you someday understand the profound meaning behind it. Then perhaps I can see you smile instead of always looking angry. So could you come and let me hit you properly with my laser, just once?

I will be waiting.
